stem:
Meera's teacher asked the class about human digestion during a science lesson in her school in Jaipur. Which of the following statements about digestion is incorrect ( )
A. Food enters the body through the mouth and travels along the alimentary canal
B. Digestion breaks complex food components like carbohydrates, proteins and fats into simpler forms
C. All digestion of food takes place only in the stomach
D. The simpler substances formed by digestion can be used by the body

options.text: Food enters the body through the mouth and travels along the alimentary canal
Digestion breaks complex food components like carbohydrates, proteins and fats into simpler forms
All digestion of food takes place only in the stomach
The simpler substances formed by digestion can be used by the body

teacher.key_rationale: Digestion occurs along the whole alimentary canal from mouth to anus, not only in the stomach, so statement C is the incorrect one; A, B and D correctly describe digestion as the breakdown of complex food components into simpler usable forms along the canal.
